title: Introduce token-level billing breakdown metrics and synthetic warmup harness
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds fine-grained token billing metrics (per-token cost buckets and phase breakdown) and a synthetic warmup harness to reduce cold-start tail and stabilize cost regressions. Backward-compatible; no API changes.
description:
Motivation: We need precise attribution of billing units to token phases and cheaper mechanisms to pre-warm model caches for improved unit economics. This PR introduces a token-level billing breakdown and a lightweight synthetic warmup harness that can be scheduled per-tenant or run as part of upgrade rollouts.

What this changes (high level): 1) Prometheus-style metrics for token_cost_cents_total, token_cost_phase_seconds, and token_cost_bucket_count with labels {tenant_id, model, route, token_phase, quantization}. 2) A synthetic warmup harness (synthetic/warmup-runner) that simulates representative prompts to prime KV caches and common batch shapes. 3) Grafana dashboard panels and alert tuning for noisy billing regressions (delta-based alert with hysteresis). 4) Opt-in feature flag and rollout plan to avoid immediate high-cardinality metric explosion.

Implementation notes: Metrics are emitted from the serving runtime on cost-finalization (end of invocation) to avoid double-counting across retries. We aggregate micro-costs into cent-resolution rollups to limit cardinality. The harness runs at low QPS by default and can be configured per-region; it uses a recorded prompt-corpus that mirrors observed prompt-shapes to exercise typical hot paths including KV cache hits and prefix warmups.

Rollout plan: feature flagged off by default. Step 1: deploy metric producers with feature flag and only enable internal orgs (redwood-testing). Step 2: enable harness in canary region for 48h and monitor token_cost_bucket_count and latency tails. Step 3: gradually roll to 10% of tenants and evaluate cost sensitivity for 7 days before full rollout.

Backward compatibility and safety: We avoided adding tenant-unique labels except tenant_id which is only enabled when the "detailed_billing_labels" org flag is on. Default metrics are per-model and per-route only. The warmup harness includes safety rate limits and a kill-switch in the console.

Testing and validation: Unit tests for metric naming and histogram bucket layout. Integration test that verifies emission on a replayed trace. Loadbench run (summary below) validated that the additional metrics add <0.4% p99 tail and synthetic warmup reduced cold-start p95 by ~18% in the canary.

Related: Linear ENG-4821 (token billing observability), ENG-4899 (warmup harness), SUP-2142 (support follow-up for tenant billing questions).

review_comments: Marco Chen: Please explain how tenant_id label is gated — worried about cardinality and billing PII.
Aisha Patel: tenant_id is gated behind detailed_billing_labels org flag; default emission uses tenant_hash instead of clear IDs and we don't enable it for free-tier orgs.
Priya Nair: Add a note in the runbook describing how to mute billing delta alerts during model rollouts.
Aisha Patel: Added runbook section and an alert_suppression window tied to rollout metadata.
Evan Ruiz: The histogram bucket boundaries look uneven; can you rationalize chosen cut points for micro-cent buckets?

Aisha Patel: We chose exponential buckets up to 100 cents with tighter resolution under 1 cent based on production cost distribution; added comment in token_metrics.go and unit tests validating bucket mapping.
ci_summary: All checks passed: unit (ok), integration (ok after one rerun due to timing flake), lint (ok), build (ok). E2E warmup smoke ran in canary and reported expected traffic profile.
loadbench_summary: Canary loadbench: +0.35% p99 runtime overhead when emitting detailed metrics at 10qps; warmup harness reduced cold-start p95 by 18% and cold-start frequency by ~30% in the canary region.
deploy_notes: Feature flag off by default. To enable for internal testing: set feature_flags.detailed_billing=true for org redwood-testing and enable harness in region us-west-2. Use console to toggle alert_suppression during rollout.
post_merge_tasks: 1) Monitor token_cost_bucket_count for unexpected cardinality growth. 2) Coordinate with billing team to validate invoice alignment. 3) Schedule follow-up perf sweep if p99 overhead >0.5%.
security_considerations: Tenant identifiers are hashed by default; detailed labels are opt-in and require SOC approval for enabling in production. No billing data exported to third-party sinks by default.
notes_for_oncall: If billing delta alerts fire after rollout, use the alert_suppression window in the console or temporarily disable detailed_billing_labels while investigating. Warmup harness has an emergency kill switch at /_internal/warmup/disable.
